source: Actions run 32573337050 (PR #1283, head 5459384) — the DESKTOP leg, job 97031981112, which is the only leg that runs both spec sets. All 31 specs passed; cypress reported 34:29 for the run against a 36:16 step, and the job's own wall clock was 37:10.
note: Seconds are per-spec wall clock as Cypress reported it, and INCLUDE tests the spec skipped — 46 of the leg's 189 tests are pending (#1019), so several entries are cheap for a reason that will change when those are written. Measured on the DESKTOP profile only; the phone leg runs the same fast/** specs at 390x844 and no passkey specs at all. Its per-spec costs are close but not identical, and one weights table for both is deliberate: the splitter only needs RELATIVE cost to pack legs, and a second table would be a second thing to keep current. The four passkey specs at ~1s (compliance, controllers, recovery, and part of onboarding-journey) are PASSKEY_FULL_STACK-gated and skip themselves; when that tier is made real they will need re-recording, not adjusting. Two entries (04-wager-creation-validation, 28-platform-fee-disclosure) had their names WRAPPED across two lines in Cypress's summary table, which is how a first pass over the log missed them; the arithmetic is the check that caught it — 33 specs summing to 2060s against a reported 2069s leaves 9s of inter-spec overhead, where the 31-spec reading left 161s.
